      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner bases subsequent decisions on incorrect information, leading to errors in the final answer.

      description: The WebSurfer may repeatedly return the same results without exploring alternative search strategies or sources.
      severity: 0.55
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebSurfer fails to adapt its search approach when initial results are inconclusive.
